val: Heads-up: Meridian Retail POC needs a short deliverable for websocket streaming + function calls. Must show: (1) proxy handshake for their ingress, (2) short-lived session token rotation pattern (<=5m), (3) deterministic JSON tool envelope for their CI, and (4) quick hosted vs Dedicated cost sketch. Who can take which?

mike: I can do the proxy handshake and a minimal node example. They run a gateway with mTLS and want the gateway to perform the upgrade.

anna: I'll draft the schema. Suggest a compact envelope named `tool_response` with fixed keys so their validators never guess. Example: `{"tool":"invoice_parser","status":"ok","result":{"total_cents":12345,"lines":[]}}` and a `status: partial` flow for page errors.

security: Note: Meridian requires customer-wrapped KMS for any persisted artifacts and explicit audit webhook. We'll include a short appendix showing our hybrid KMS flow and default retention (logs 30d, ephemeral payloads not stored).

mike: Handshake sketch for gateway: `POST https://gateway.meridian.local/v1/handshake` with client certs used for mTLS and `Authorization: Bearer <sts-token>` header. Body: `{"proto":"websocket","features":{"functions":true,"structured_output":true}}`. Response includes `session_token`, `wss_url`, `expires_in`. Gateway opens ws and forwards `Authorization: Bearer <session_token>` on the connection.

anna: Validator-friendly schema (add to repo):
```json
{"tool_response":{
  "id":"uuid",
  "tool":"invoice_parser",
  "status":"ok|partial|error",
  "result":{"total_cents":12345,"currency":"USD","lines":[{"line_no":1,"amount_cents":12345}]},
  "errors":[{"page":3,"code":"ocr_fail","message":"low_confidence"}]
}}
```
We will include a tiny jsonschema and a pytest that fails on extra keys.

security: For token rotation show STS -> gateway exchanges short-lived STS token -> control plane issues conn-scoped session token TTL 4m. Sample rotate loop in node: `fetch STS -> POST /v1/handshake -> open ws -> set timer to refresh at 3m30s and swap token gracefully`. We'll add a script.

mike: Concurrency note: default 8 active function calls per ws conn. Recommend N connections for parallelism; will add a simple sizing formula in the doc. Also recommend batching + prefix_kv cache to trim token usage (~25-35%). Sample config: `batching: { max_batch_tokens: 4096, max_latency_ms: 25 } cache: { prefix_kv: true }`.

val: Pricing ask: they predict 160 rps sustained, bursts to 600 for ingest windows. Provide hosted estimate and a Dedicated commit option with discounts.

ops-bot: repo created: integrations/meridian-invoice-poc (private). README stub added.

anna: Quick hosted math (placeholder): assume 170 tokens/req, hosted rate $0.00085/token -> monthly = 160*170*3600*24*30*0.00085 ~ $5,800. We'll produce a cleaned table and show Dedicated at ~30% off based on commit size.

security: Also include `partial` semantics recommendation: `status: partial` plus per-item `errors` so their downstream can reconcile without full retries.

val: Action items: mike -> handshake + node token rotation script + sizing formula (ETA EOD), anna -> jsonschema + pytest + examples (ETA EOD), security -> KMS appendix + retention + questionnaire attach (ETA tomorrow). I'll assemble a 1-pager for tomorrow's call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
